title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
statement_short: Given an unsorted array of integers nums, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time.
hint: Strict O(n) time requirement prevents sorting, mandating O(1) set lookups to find sequence starts.
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set stores elements in a hash set, starting length counting only when (num - 1) is absent, achieving O(n) time. Not Sorting: Sorting numbers finds consecutive elements easily but costs O(n log n) time, violating the strict O(n) constraint. Not Union-Find: Union-Find connects adjacent elements in O(n * alpha(n)) time, which is slightly more complex than set lookups. Not Sliding Window: Numbers are unsorted and non-contiguous in memory, preventing sliding subsegment windows.
